description: Official source discovery registry for Policy Intelligence. Tracks source owners, endpoints, feeds, search surfaces, capture strategy, and known automation status.

sources.name: Acquisition.gov
sources.notes: Current source for FAR/DFARS pages and acquisition regulatory material.

sources.name: Acquisition.gov DFARS
sources.notes: Dedicated DFARS/PGI lane for defense acquisition clauses and cybersecurity acquisition references.

sources.name: Acquisition.gov FAR
sources.notes: Dedicated FAR lane for clause/part-level discovery and direct inventory prefilters.

sources.name: Congress.gov
sources.notes: Best source for pre-enactment bill and legislative-status metadata before GovInfo public law capture.

sources.name: Defense Pricing, Contracting, and Acquisition Policy
sources.notes: Official DPCAP/DARS source for acquisition policy, class deviations, DFARS, and PGI material adjacent to FAR/DFARS text.

sources.name: Department of the Navy Issuances
sources.notes: Canonical DON source for SECNAV and OPNAV PDFs; blocks simple automated fetch.

sources.name: DISA STIG Library
sources.notes: Implementation-control source for STIG/SRG baselines and technical security requirements.

sources.name: DoD CIO
sources.notes: Official strategy/guidance source; bot protection currently requires browser/manual lane.

sources.name: DoW/DoD Issuances
sources.source_owner: Washington Headquarters Services / Executive Services Directorate
sources.notes: Official source often blocks automated PDF fetches. Keep source-known records and route to browser/manual capture.

sources.name: Federal Register
sources.source_owner: Office of the Federal Register / National Archives and Records Administration
sources.notes: API is keyless and suitable for presidential documents and agency notices.

sources.name: GovInfo
sources.notes: Canonical public source for public laws, congressional documents, and GPO packages.

sources.name: National Archives Executive Orders
sources.notes: Backstop index for historical Executive Orders not easily resolved through current Federal Register API search.

sources.name: NIST CSRC
sources.source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Landing-page source for NIST publications; NVL pubs often hosts the canonical PDF bytes.

sources.name: NIST Publications
sources.source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Broad NIST publication lane beyond CSRC landing pages, including FIPS and IR documents.

sources.name: OMB
sources.notes: OMB has its own issuing authority even when files are hosted under WhiteHouse.gov.

sources.name: OMB Circulars
sources.notes: Separates durable OMB circular authority from the more volatile WhiteHouse.gov host bucket.

sources.name: U.S. Code
sources.source_owner: Office of the Law Revision Counsel
sources.notes: Canonical U.S. Code HTML/XML source for codified authority.

sources.name: White House
sources.notes: Useful host for OMB/OSTP memoranda and PDFs; issuing authority must be tracked separately.

sources.name: White House Presidential Actions
sources.notes: Current White House issue lane for new executive orders and presidential memoranda before codified downstream artifacts appear.

sources.name: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office
sources.source_owner: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office
sources.notes: DoD AI/data governance and reference-design source beyond formal DoD issuances.

sources.name: CISA
sources.notes: Target source for CISA maturity models, alerts, and implementation guidance.

sources.name: CISA Guidance Library
sources.notes: Broader CISA resource lane, including BODs, implementation guidance, and maturity models.

sources.name: CJCS Directives Library
issuing_authority_scope: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
sources.notes: Dedicated CJCS issuance lane for instructions, manuals, notices, and guides.

sources.name: Committee on National Security Systems
sources.notes: National security systems policy lane that frequently binds DoD cyber/security artifacts.

sources.name: DAU Adaptive Acquisition Framework
sources.notes: Reference-design and acquisition pathway guidance source for interpreting formal acquisition policy.

sources.name: DoD Cyber Exchange
sources.notes: Automated HTML capture can return a shell page; extraction quality checks must catch this.

sources.name: eCFR
sources.source_owner: Office of the Federal Register / National Archives and Records Administration
sources.notes: Point-in-time regulatory source; important for FAR/CFR alignment.

sources.name: FedRAMP
sources.notes: Cloud authorization source for baselines, templates, digital documentation, and implementation guidance referenced by DoD cloud policy.

sources.name: GovInfo CFR Packages
sources.notes: Annual-edition CFR package coverage complements current eCFR API snapshots.

sources.name: Joint Electronic Library
issuing_authority_scope: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
sources.notes: Joint doctrine source distinct from CJCS directive/control issuance source.

sources.name: MyNavyHR
sources.notes: Official message archive for NAVADMIN/ALNAV text; bot protection blocks simple fetch.

sources.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
sources.source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: AI governance source for RMF core, playbooks, profiles, and crosswalk artifacts.

sources.name: NIST NCCoE
sources.notes: Reference-design lane for implementable cybersecurity architecture and practice guides.

sources.name: Office of Science and Technology Policy
sources.source_owner: Office of Science and Technology Policy
sources.notes: Source for AI, R&D, research-security, and emerging technology governance artifacts.

sources.name: USD(A&S)
sources.source_owner: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment
sources.notes: Acquisition and sustainment policy/guidance source upstream of DPC and DAU reference material.

sources.name: Air Force e-Publishing
sources.notes: Air Force service-policy source for later cross-service coverage.

sources.name: Army Doctrine Publications
sources.notes: Army doctrine lane complements Army regulations and DA pamphlets.

sources.name: Army Publishing Directorate
sources.notes: Army service-policy source for later cross-service coverage.

sources.name: DAU ACQuipedia
sources.notes: Policy-adjacent reference lane for acquisition concepts that show up in requirements and instructions.

sources.name: DISA
sources.notes: Likely source for implementation and technical policy-adjacent artifacts.

sources.name: GSA Policy and Regulations
sources.notes: Civil-agency policy source for property, technology, and acquisition references that feed DoD governance.

sources.name: Joint Staff Directives
issuing_authority_scope: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
sources.notes: Needed for joint instruction/manual coverage.

sources.name: Law Library of Congress
sources.notes: Reference lane for legal-history and codification context when GovInfo/OLRC are not enough.

sources.name: MARADMIN Messages
sources.notes: Marine message lane separate from publications library for transient implementation guidance.

sources.name: Marine Corps Publications Electronic Library
sources.notes: Marine Corps policy/message source for later cross-service coverage.

sources.name: NAVAIR
sources.notes: Candidate lower-echelon source. Requires discovery before artifact rules are trusted.

sources.name: NAVSEA
sources.notes: Candidate lower-echelon source. Requires discovery before artifact rules are trusted.

sources.name: NAVWAR
sources.notes: Candidate lower-echelon source for Navy cyber/software implementation guidance.

sources.name: NAVSUP
sources.notes: Navy supply, logistics, and enterprise-system policy lane.

sources.name: Office of Naval Research
sources.notes: Navy research and innovation acquisition lane.

sources.name: Military Sealift Command
sources.notes: Sealift logistics and procurement governance lane.

sources.name: Strategic Systems Programs
sources.notes: Strategic weapons systems command lane for Navy program governance.

sources.name: Navy Cyber Forces
sources.notes: Navy cyber command manual and operational cybersecurity lane.

sources.name: Navy Warfare Library
sources.notes: Navy doctrine lane for lower-level operating concepts and reference designs.

sources.name: NSA Cybersecurity Guidance
sources.notes: Cyber hardening and reference-design source for national security systems and DoD implementation work.

sources.name: OPM Policy
sources.notes: Federal personnel policy source for human-resources references in DoD personnel issuances.

sources.name: Space Force Doctrine
sources.notes: Space Force doctrine and service-guidance lane for space-specific downstream references.

sources.name: TRADOC Publications
sources.source_owner: U.S. Army Training and Doctrine Command
sources.notes: Lower-echelon Army policy and doctrine source that is not fully represented in APD search alone.

sources.name: U.S. Cyber Command
sources.notes: Combatant-command source for cyber strategy and downstream operational guidance.

sources.name: USD(R&E)
sources.source_owner: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering
sources.notes: Research and engineering policy/guidance source for technology strategy and reference-design artifacts.

sources.name: Air Force Materiel Command
sources.notes: Lower-echelon Air Force source for materiel, acquisition, and technical implementation guidance.

sources.name: Coast Guard Directives System
sources.notes: Uniformed-service policy lane outside DoD, useful when statutes or joint references cite Coast Guard policy.

sources.name: NAVFAC
sources.notes: Lower-echelon engineering and facilities policy source.

sources.name: PEO Digital
sources.source_owner: Program Executive Office Digital and Enterprise Services
sources.notes: Program-office guidance lane for Navy enterprise IT and digital-service implementation artifacts.

sources.name: U.S. Special Operations Command
sources.notes: Combatant-command policy-adjacent source for special operations guidance and acquisition references.
